answer: An agent economy can mitigate Sybil attacks by using hardware attestation to anchor cryptographic identities to secure enclaves. An attacker incurs the scarce capital expense of purchasing discrete silicon chips per alias, preventing fake nodes from streaking through the cluster like a comet. Validators verify these signed platform certificates at the dawn of each session. However, silicon supply-chain bottlenecks and microarchitectural side-channel attacks can weaken this defense.
